senses.gloss: f.(h. form מוֹדָעָה) (יְדַע) declaration, esp. protest before witnesses against a forced or unduly influenced action.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 40a:6">B. Bath. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>לא כתבינן מ׳ אלא אמאן וכ׳</he> we write a protest only against a person who does not submit to law.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 40b:5">Ib. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>הויא מ׳ לחברתה</he> the order to write a deed of donation in secret is a protest annulling a subsequent disposal by deed.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 49a:4">Ib. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ היו דברינו</he> if witnesses subscribed to a deed say, We signed after the owner had entered a verbal protest before us against the deed; a. fr.
